'''Tiedra''' is the [[innkeeper]] at the [[The Great Tree]] in [[Cairhien]].

==Appearance==
Tiedra is a plump woman with an unctuous manner and sharp eyes.

==Activities==
Tiedra welcomes [[Verin]] when she arrives with [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Hurin]], [[Ingtar]], [[Mat]], [[Perrin]] and [[Loial]] to The Great Tree after the [[Horn of Valere]] and [[Ruby-hilted dagger]] are stolen again.{{ref/book|2|31}}.
